**3B.9 Research Note: Ali Khamenei (2024)**

**Bottom line:** I found no solid evidence that Khamenei handled domestic crises in 2024 with a general strategy of protection and restraint. The dominant pattern is crackdown, surveillance, executions, and impunity. The only positive signals are narrow and procedural: a temporary pause in implementing the stricter hijab law and occasional prisoner pardons/commutations.

| Title | Publisher | Date | Recoverable URL | Claim-level summary | QIDs |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---|
| [Iran: Draconian campaign to enforce compulsory veiling laws through surveillance and mass car confiscations](https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/03/iran-draconian-campaign-to-enforce-compulsory-veiling-laws-through-surveillance-and-mass-car-confiscations/) | Amnesty International | 2024-03-06 | https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/03/iran-draconian-campaign-to-enforce-compulsory-veiling-laws-through-surveillance-and-mass-car-confiscations/ | Amnesty described surveillance, mass police checks, confiscations, prosecutions, flogging, prison terms, and “morality” classes used to enforce veiling rules. This is a coercive, fear-based response to domestic social tension, not restrained crisis management. | 3B.9; also 3B.5, 3B.8, 3B.2 |
| [Iran chokehold on dissent](https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/01/11/iran-chokehold-dissent) | Human Rights Watch | 2024-01-11 | https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/01/11/iran-chokehold-dissent | HRW reported that authorities killed hundreds of protesters, arrested thousands, and tortured detainees while failing to open transparent investigations. That is direct evidence against protection or restraint in response to domestic unrest. | 3B.9; also 3B.8, 3B.1, 3B.2 |
| [Iran executes 853 people in eight-year high amid relentless repression and renewed war on drugs](https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/04/iran-executes-853-people-in-eight-year-high-amid-relentless-repression-and-renewed-war-on-drugs/) | Amnesty International | 2024-04-04 | https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/04/iran-executes-853-people-in-eight-year-high-amid-relentless-repression-and-renewed-war-on-drugs/ | Amnesty reported a major execution surge, including mass use of the death penalty after unfair Revolutionary Court trials. This indicates punitive escalation during domestic crisis conditions rather than de-escalation. | 3B.9; also 3B.8, 3B.1, 3B.2 |
| [Iran security forces rape, torture detainees](https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/04/22/iran-security-forces-rape-torture-detainees) | Human Rights Watch | 2024-04-22 | https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/04/22/iran-security-forces-rape-torture-detainees | HRW documented rape, torture, sexual assault, and coerced false confessions during the protest crackdown. This is evidence of violent repression rather than protection or restraint in a spontaneous crisis. | 3B.9; also 3B.8, 3B.1, 3B.2, 3B.4 |
| [Iran: Two years after ‘Woman Life Freedom’ uprising, impunity for crimes reigns supreme](https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/09/iran-two-years-after-woman-life-freedom-uprising-impunity-for-crimes-reigns-supreme/) | Amnesty International | 2024-09-11 | https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/09/iran-two-years-after-woman-life-freedom-uprising-impunity-for-crimes-reigns-supreme/ | Amnesty said there were still no effective, impartial investigations into killings, torture, sexual violence, or disappearances, and that families were harassed and arbitrarily detained. This shows continued retaliation and impunity, not protective crisis response. | 3B.9; also 3B.8, 3B.1, 3B.2, 3B.4 |
| [Leader approves pardoning, commuting sentences of about 3,000 Iranian convicts](https://www.presstv.ir/Detail/2024/09/20/733636/Leader-approves-pardoning-convicts) | Press TV | 2024-09-20 | https://www.presstv.ir/Detail/2024/09/20/733636/Leader-approves-pardoning-convicts | Khamenei approved pardons or commutations for 2,887 convicts, including some security-related cases and minors. This is the clearest positive item, but it is discretionary clemency, not a broader non-retaliatory crisis policy. | 3B.9; also 3B.1, 3B.8 |
| [Iran pauses implementation of stricter hijab law for women](https://www.euronews.com/2024/12/18/iran-pauses-implementation-of-stricter-hijab-law-for-women) | Euronews / AP | 2024-12-18 | https://www.euronews.com/2024/12/18/iran-pauses-implementation-of-stricter-hijab-law-for-women | Senior bodies paused implementation of the stricter hijab law for the time being. This is a limited restraint signal, but it is procedural and temporary rather than durable protection from coercive social control. | 3B.9; also 3B.7, 3B.5 |

**Search gap**
- I found no reliable 2024 evidence of a sustained domestic-crisis strategy built around protection, restraint, and non-retaliation.
- The positive evidence is limited to narrow clemency and a temporary pause on hijab-law implementation.
- I found no convincing proof of a broader shift away from intimidation, collective punishment, censorship, or militarized spectacle in response to domestic flare-ups.
